description:
Why this issue exists: In blob.rs, blob_download() only performs the account_id ownership check when an AuthenticatedUser extension is present. In dev mode (auth.required=false), no middleware injects AuthenticatedUser, so the ownership guard is silently skipped. Any unauthenticated client can download any IPFS block by supplying any account_id value.

What needs to be done: The ownership check must be enforced independently of whether auth is enabled. In dev mode, either (a) use a synthetic dev-user identity so the ownership path still runs, or (b) accept all requests but log a warning on each unauthenticated blob fetch. Option (a) is safer. The current behavior exposes all stored email blobs to unauthenticated reads when dev mode is active and JMAP is configured.
title: blob_download: account ownership check skipped in dev mode
